items.event_time_ist: Tuesday, Oct 13, 2026 (tanker ~11:00 PM IST / 17:30 UTC; container ship time undisclosed)
items.summary: UKMTO said on Tuesday that a container ship AND a tanker were struck by unknown projectiles within the Strait of Hormuz, with authorities investigating and no further details yet. This upgrades the 12:55 PM PDT alert, which had only the off-Khasab tanker (17:30 UTC, fire extinguished, crew safe) as UKMTO-confirmed and the container ship as merely 'suggested' by regional graphics. Two commercial vessels hit in one day inside the strait.
items.title: UKMTO confirms a container ship AND a tanker struck by unknown projectiles in the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday
